title: WGP-ABF Module Data Contract v0.6
description: A machine-readable contract for data and exchange-protocol alignment at agent-module boundaries. It standardizes assembly data, field meaning, and execution semantics without constraining either module's internal implementation.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

schemaContentHash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 JSON serialization of the complete Schema document. Whitespace and object-member order in the source file do not affect this digest.

schemaResolutionRecord.description: Optional deployment-local resolution metadata for one exact schema. It is not part of ModuleDataContract or SchemaBundle identity.

schemaContentHash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 JSON serialization of the complete Schema document.

schemaRefClosureEntry.description: One resolved external $ref edge. Together the entries must equal the complete transitive external-reference closure found in the bundled schema documents.

schemaBundle.description: An immutable bundle whose content hash covers every listed schema and the complete transitive external-$ref closure.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted and every externalRefClosure member included.

contractCompatibilityAssessment.description: A directed, time-bounded compatibility result for two exact ModuleDataContracts. It is independent from whole-part I0-I4 interchangeability.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

direction.description: The assessment always evaluates sourceContract to targetContract. Reverse compatibility requires a separate assessment with swapped exact references.

dataLossApproval.description: A directed, time-bounded approval for dropping one exact source field while migrating between two exact Contracts. It is independent from permission policy and never approves another pointer by implication.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

contractMigrationPlan.description: A directed migration plan between two exact ModuleDataContracts. The source contract never reverse-references this plan, avoiding a content-hash cycle.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

schemaContentHash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 JSON serialization of the complete Schema document. This is a canonical JSON digest, not a raw-file byte digest.

schemaBundleRef.description: Exact bundle pin whose content hash covers this schema and the complete transitive external-$ref closure.

connectionCardinality.description: Allowed number of bound consumer connections. This is not payload or message cardinality.
